reel_input.doctrine: People rarely choose against themselves. They accumulate tiny points of resistance until surrender feels rational.
reel_input.doctrine_statement: The peak of friction is the edge of ignition. What feels like maximum resistance is the minimum force required to generate the heat.
reel_input.perceptual_anchor: ignition_moment — the microsecond when crystallographic structure crosses ignition temperature
reel_input.pipeline: dreamforge_3.0 — full Thinker → Designer → Director → Compiler derivation

theme: The peak of friction is the edge of ignition. What feels like maximum resistance is the minimum force required to generate the heat.
core_metaphor: Static friction exceeds kinetic friction — maximum resistance is always at initiation, never permanent. The person who stops at peak static friction has stopped at the only moment the fire was possible.
emotional_arc: entrapment → compound accumulation → maximum resistance → ignition → recurrence
visual_register: Crystallographic Forensics — extreme macro on match head crystal lattice and friction surface contact zone. The viewer is placed inside the mechanism, watching the physics that produces the doctrine. No hands. No bodies. Evidence only.

frame_geometry.runway_prompt_char_budget_note: lib/scene-planning.ts MAX_RUNWAY_PROMPT_CHARS truncates promptText to 1000 chars. Keep each visual_prompt <= 1000 chars.

visual_thread.lighting_quality: analytical — reveals crystalline structure, not atmosphere
visual_thread.recurring_element: match head crystal lattice and friction surface contact zone

mobius_loop.description: The Möbius is structural rather than grammatical. S1 opens on a cold unlit surface in void. S5 closes on a new cold unlit surface in void — visually identical register. On loop restart, the viewer sees the S5 surface cut to S1, and the narration 'You do not choose against yourself. You accumulate.' applies retroactively to the surface they just watched in S5. The cycle is visible.
mobius_loop.loop_seam: 'The next surface is already waiting.' → [cut] → 'You do not choose against yourself.'
mobius_loop.visual_seam: S5 locked-static on cold unlit crystal surface → hard cut to S1 locked-static on cold unlit crystal surface. Identical palette register. The viewer cannot tell which surface is which.

audio_design.final_segment_treatment: Final segment: stability 0.55, style 0.0. 'Waiting.' — the word holds, then silence before loop.
audio_design.music_fade: Sub-bass sustained tone fades over final 2s, cut at loop seam

script.full_text:
You do not choose against yourself.

You accumulate.

Each point of resistance —
minor. Rational. Survivable.

Until surrender feels rational.

You are not wrong to feel it.

You are wrong about what it means.

The moment that feels impossible
is the only moment the fire begins.

You do not overcome friction.

The next surface is already waiting.

subtitle_position.safe_zone_compliance: Instagram Reels UI safe zone — no subtitle content below 18% from bottom
subtitle_position.line_break_rule: Max 5 words per line. Semantic breaks only — never break mid-phrase

sound_brief.emotional_register: thermal pressure building toward ignition — not anxiety, sustained heat
sound_brief.instrumentation_direction: Sub-bass sustained tone that rises in frequency imperceptibly from S1 to S4. Sparse single low-frequency percussion strike on S3 pivot. Minimal metallic overtone on S4 ignition. Sub-bass fades to silence in S5.
sound_brief.energy_arc: Near-silence in S1-S2 (cold, before contact) → sustained bass tone building through S3 (heat accumulating) → single resonant metallic strike at ignition S4 → sustained tone fades in S5 (new cold surface, cycle resets to near-silence)
sound_brief.suno_search_string: dark minimal sub-bass sustained drone crystallographic tension 76bpm cold precision
explicit_exclusions: no fire/combustion sound design — this is physics, not metaphor

music_config.description: Sub-bass sustained tone rising from near-silence (S1) through accumulated heat (S3) to single resonant metallic strike at ignition (S4), fading to near-silence again (S5). The music mirrors the thermal arc of the visual system.
music_config.loop_seam_note: Near-silence at seam — loop restart begins at the same near-silence register.

cover_frame_spec.rationale: S4 resolution at approximately 0:32 — full four-color palette present, crystallographic ignition at maximum visual weight. The perceptual anchor frame.

execution_directive.note: Cover rendered by code. No CLI strings in JSON by design.

instagram_config.alt_text: Extreme macro crystallographic visualization of a match head at the moment of ignition — gold thermal lines crossing threshold, crimson transformation propagating through crystal lattice, brutalist CAD precision.

production_notes.critical_rendering_risk: Crystallographic precision at extreme macro. Runway may default to organic/fluid aesthetics. Prompts specify: geometric, angular, lattice structure, crystal faces, CAD precision. Anti-drift: no soft, organic, fluid, smoke, diffuse.
production_notes.fallback_strategy: If crystallographic geometry fails to hold across clips, fall back to friction surface geometry (phosphorus strip ruled pattern) — the other side of the contact zone. Doctrine still holds.
production_notes.dreamforge_generation: First reel produced by full DreamForge 3.0 pipeline — Thinker → Designer → Director → Compiler. All decisions traceable to upstream artifacts. Provenance Law verified.
